newsitem.title: UK: Glynwed eyes 100 mln stg purchases - report.
newsitem.headline: Glynwed eyes 100 mln stg purchases - report.

text.p: Industrial group Glynwed International Plc will look for acquistions worth up to 100 million pounds ($157.9 million) as part of a strategy to reshape the group, the Financial Times reported on Wednesday.
The newspaper said the metals distribution to Aga cookers group had indicated it would invest in its consumer products and pipe systems divisions.
The Financial Times said finance director Tony Wilson had said the company's attitude to its cyclical businesses, particularly metal distribution, was no longer favourable.
But the newspaper added that Wilson had suggested the metals distribution business would not be sold in the short term.

It said Glynwed was to acquire a manufacturing base in the U.S. to enhance its catering equipment operations and planned to expand its pipe systems business through wider distribution on the east coast of the U.S. and in emerging markets in South America and the Asia Pacific.
Glynwed said on Tuesday first half pre-tax profits rose to 43.9 million pounds from 40.2 million pounds previously and that it would pay out an unchanged interim dividend of 4.4 pence per share.
